-- ============================================================
-- Metadata Control Schema for Medallion ELT Framework
-- Run once against the Azure SQL Database metadata store
-- ============================================================

-- Create control schema
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'ctrl')
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA ctrl');
GO

-- ============================================================
-- ctrl.SourceTable  – registry of every source table to ingest
-- ============================================================
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.objects
    WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'ctrl.SourceTable') AND type = 'U'
)
CREATE TABLE ctrl.SourceTable (
    SourceTableId        INT            IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    SourceConnectionName NVARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,           -- e.g. 'contoso'
    TableName            NVARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,           -- e.g. 'customer'
    PrimaryKey           NVARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,           -- e.g. 'CustomerKey'
    ColumnList           NVARCHAR(MAX)  NOT NULL,           -- comma-sep column names for hash
    ColumnTypeList       NVARCHAR(MAX)  NOT NULL,           -- CAST expressions for type enforcement
    LoadType             NVARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INCREMENTAL', -- FULL | INCREMENTAL
    IsActive             BIT            NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    DetectDeletes        BIT            NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    SilverEnabled        BIT            NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    GoldEnabled          BIT            NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    SilverQuery          NVARCHAR(MAX)  NULL,               -- optional override query for silver layer
    GoldQuery            NVARCHAR(MAX)  NULL,               -- optional override query for gold layer
    CreatedDate          DATETIME2      NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    ModifiedDate         DATETIME2      NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_SourceTable UNIQUE (SourceConnectionName, TableName)
);
GO

-- ============================================================
-- ctrl.Watermark  – tracks last successful load per source table
-- ============================================================
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.objects
    WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'ctrl.Watermark') AND type = 'U'
)
CREATE TABLE ctrl.Watermark (
    WatermarkId      INT       IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    SourceTableId    INT       NOT NULL REFERENCES ctrl.SourceTable(SourceTableId),
    LastLoadDate     DATE      NOT NULL,
    LastWatermarkTS  DATETIME2 NULL,
    UpdatedDate      DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Watermark UNIQUE (SourceTableId)
);
GO

-- ============================================================
-- ctrl.PipelineExecution  – end-to-end audit log per run
-- ============================================================
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM sys.objects
    WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'ctrl.PipelineExecution') AND type = 'U'
)
CREATE TABLE ctrl.PipelineExecution (
    ExecutionId          INT            IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    PipelineName         NVARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,
    RunId                NVARCHAR(100)  NOT NULL,
    SourceTableId        INT            NULL REFERENCES ctrl.SourceTable(SourceTableId),
    SourceConnectionName NVARCHAR(200)  NULL,
    TableName            NVARCHAR(200)  NULL,
    Layer                NVARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,  -- BRONZE | SILVER | GOLD
    LoadDate             DATE           NULL,
    StartTime            DATETIME2      NOT NULL DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    EndTime              DATETIME2      NULL,
    Status               NVARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RUNNING', -- RUNNING | SUCCESS | FAILED
    RowsRead             BIGINT         NULL,
    RowsWritten          BIGINT         NULL,
    ErrorMessage         NVARCHAR(MAX)  NULL
);
GO

-- ============================================================
-- Seed data: contoso/customer example (matches existing POC)
-- ============================================================
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM ctrl.SourceTable
    WHERE SourceConnectionName = 'contoso' AND TableName = 'customer'
)
INSERT INTO ctrl.SourceTable (
    SourceConnectionName,
    TableName,
    PrimaryKey,
    ColumnList,
    ColumnTypeList,
    LoadType,
    IsActive,
    DetectDeletes,
    SilverEnabled,
    GoldEnabled
)
VALUES (
    'contoso',
    'customer',
    'CustomerKey',
    '[CustomerKey],[GeoAreaKey],[StartDT],[EndDT],[Continent],[Gender],[Title],[GivenName],[MiddleInitial],[Surname],[StreetAddress],[City],[State],[StateFull],[ZipCode],[Country],[CountryFull],[Birthday],[Age],[Occupation],[Company],[Vehicle],[Latitude],[Longitude]',
    'CAST([CustomerKey] AS INT) AS CustomerKey,CAST([GeoAreaKey] AS INT) AS GeoAreaKey,CAST([StartDT] AS DATETIME2(7)) AS StartDT,CAST([EndDT] AS DATETIME2(7)) AS EndDT,CAST([Continent] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Continent,CAST([Gender] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Gender,CAST([Title] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Title,CAST([GivenName] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS GivenName,CAST([MiddleInitial] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS MiddleInitial,CAST([Surname] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Surname,CAST([StreetAddress] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS StreetAddress,CAST([City] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS City,CAST([State] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS State,CAST([StateFull] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS StateFull,CAST([ZipCode] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS ZipCode,CAST([Country] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Country,CAST([CountryFull] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS CountryFull,CAST([Birthday] AS DATETIME2(7)) AS Birthday,CAST([Age] AS INT) AS Age,CAST([Occupation] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Occupation,CAST([Company] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Company,CAST([Vehicle] AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS Vehicle,CAST([Latitude] AS NUMERIC(20,5)) AS Latitude,CAST([Longitude] AS NUMERIC(20,5)) AS Longitude',
    'INCREMENTAL',
    1,
    1,
    1,
    0
);
GO
